subject: Demo request: Redwood + OpenLib GitHub integration
messages:
From: Jordan Smith <jordan@openlib.dev>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-28T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request: Redwood + OpenLib GitHub integration

Hi Camila,

I signed up for Redwood's hosted API last week after seeing the GitHub integration notes on your docs - big fan of the open-source-first approach. I'm part of the infra team at OpenLib (we maintain a few public repos and a CLI that integrates with CI).

We have a couple of integration questions and would love to see a short demo focused on:
- GitHub Actions / webhook support and recommended patterns for using Redwood in CI/CD
- Repo-level access controls and secrets handling for private repos
- Any example workflows for auto-deploying model updates from a repo

Would you be available for a 30-min demo next week? Happy to share a brief agenda - goal is to validate fit and understand any implementation work.

Thanks,
Jordan Smith
Infrastructure Engineer, OpenLib
jordan@openlib.dev

--
Attachment: OpenLib-infra-diagram.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan@openlib.dev>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-28T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood + OpenLib GitHub integration

Hi Jordan - great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for signing up!

I can definitely run a 30-minute session and tailor it to the items you listed. Aditya (cc'd) is our SDR/AE for developer accounts and will help coordinate. A few proposed slots next week (PDT):
- Tue 2026-06-30 10:00-10:30
- Tue 2026-06-30 14:00-14:30
- Wed 2026-07-01 09:00-09:30

Please pick whichever works best and we'll send a calendar invite. For the demo, do you want the focus to be a short run-through of: repo webhooks -> Redwood request routing, a sample GitHub Actions config, and how to handle secrets/KMS? If there are any internal security/compliance folks we should include, flag them and we can add a quick 10-min Q&A at the end.

Pre-demo asks (helps us prep):
- Are you on public or private repos we need to consider?
- Do you expect to self-host Redwood Private or use hosted API for the initial rollout?

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai
Calendly: https://calendly.com/camila-redwood/30

--
Attachment: None

From: Jordan Smith <jordan@openlib.dev>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maggie Li <maggie@openlib.dev>
Date: 2026-06-29T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood + OpenLib GitHub integration

Hi Camila - thanks for the quick reply. Tue 2026-06-30 14:00 PDT works great for us. Can you include our tech lead Maggie (cc'd) - she'll drive the integration questions.

Answers to your pre-demo asks:
- Primary work is on private repos, but we have a few public repos as well.
- For the pilot we expect to use hosted API, but we're evaluating Redwood Private for a later stage (data residency & audit reasons).

I've attached a short doc with our top questions and an example of our CI pipeline (high level). If you can share a 15-min pre-demo agenda and whether we should share any repo access beforehand, that would be helpful.

Thanks,
Jordan

--

Perfect - thanks for confirming. I've added Alex (engineering solutions) to the thread so he can cover GitHub Actions examples and secrets/KMS patterns.

Proposed 30-min agenda for Tue 2026-06-30 14:00-14:30 PDT:
1) 5m quick intros + current setup
2) 10m demo: GitHub Actions -> Redwood hosted API flow + webhook examples
3) 10m tech Q&A: secrets, repo access, self-host vs hosted considerations
4) 5m next steps & mutual action plan

I've created a calendar invite and attached the .ics - please accept when convenient. Also linking the HubSpot record for this account so Aditya can follow up: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/89012345

If you'd like Alex to pull any specific repo snippets into the demo, please share a small sample or read-only access ahead of time.

See you Tuesday!

Best,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai
